title: Replying to @Jessica Going #gatz #greatgatsby #thegreatgatsby #theatr...
transcript: Well, if you're like this person and your biggest regret in life is missing the play GATS, then you're in luck, because it's coming back to New York starting November 1st at the Public Theater. I will not be seeing it again. Not because I didn't like it, but because it's an eight hour commitment and I. I just don't need to do it twice. But if you haven't seen it, I would highly recommend it if you think it might be your cup of tea. I am really happy it's coming back, because, as I said in that video from November, uh, with all these Great Gatsby adaptations, I think GATS was being criminally left out of the conversation. And they said, screw that, we're back, baby!
